notes.title: Work Life Balance Demo Update v1.2
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
We’ve just released an update for the demo. The main changes are as follows:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Stealth Stage Visual Clarity[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved scene lighting and contrast to make paths and interactable areas easier to see.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Portrait Display Fix[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resolved an issue where character portraits could display incorrectly after loading from [b]Auto Save[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]NPC Pathing Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upgraded NPC auto-movement logic for smoother, more reliable routing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]macOS Language Update Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the download size when switching languages on macOS for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Miscellaneous Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Additional stability and minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p]Please update your demo and enjoy the improvements! Your feedback is always welcome.[/p]

notes.title: Work Life Balance Demo Update v1.1
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
We’ve just released an update for the demo. The main changes are as follows:[/p][p][b]1. Stealth Stage Difficulty Adjustment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added an option to skip the stage after 5 deaths, allowing players stuck at this part to continue with the story.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]2. New Load Option[/b][/p][list][*][p]After failing the stealth stage, you can now choose to load your save directly to reduce repeated attempts.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]3. Improved Controller Support[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced controller detection accuracy and improved the wording of controller operation prompts.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]4. Art Asset Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated and refined certain art assets in the stealth stage.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]5. Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed several known issues to improve overall stability.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please update your demo and enjoy the improvements! Your feedback is always welcome.[/p]

notes.title: Work Life Balance – Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to announce that the [b]demo for our pixel-art narrative RPG, [i]Work Life Balance[/i], is now live on Steam![/b][/p][p]In this demo, you'll step into the mysterious "Work Life Balance Fellowship" and begin your journey to uncover the meaning of life and work—or perhaps, the truth behind it all.
We hope you enjoy this suspenseful and thought-provoking experience![/p][hr][/hr][p]【Genre】
Story-driven, Exploration RPG[/p][hr][/hr][p]【Demo Playtime】
Approx. 15–30 minutes
(Full version: estimated 3–5 hours)[/p][hr][/hr][p]【Supported Systems】
Windows / macOS[/p][hr][/hr][p]【Languages Supported】
Simplified Chinese / English / Japanese[/p][hr][/hr][p]【Important Notes】[/p][list][*][p][b]For macOS users[/b]: Some Mac users may see a "Not Supported" warning on the Steam page. However, we’ve confirmed that [b]64-bit Mac devices can run the game normally[/b], so feel free to install and play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Naming input details[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]With keyboard & mouse, you can enter any characters including Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p]With a controller, the naming screen only supports English characters.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]If you like what you see, please consider adding 【Work Life Balance】 to your wishlist!
Wishlists mean a lot to indie developers and help you get notified of future updates.[/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter any bugs or have feedback or suggestions, feel free to leave a comment in the community.
We read everything and will continue working to improve the game.[/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p]
— LandUni Studio[/p]

notes.title: Work Life Balance Demo Launches on August 8!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,
We’re excited to announce that the [b]Work Life Balance demo will officially launch on Steam on August 8![/b][/p][p]This is a [b]story-driven RPG[/b] that focuses on exploration, deduction, and meaningful choices.
In the demo, you’ll be able to experience the opening chapter of the game and immerse yourself in its unique world and atmosphere.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Don’t forget to add the game to your [u]WISHLIST[/u]！[/b]
so you’ll be notified the moment the demo goes live.[/p][p]Thank you all so much for your continued support,
and we hope you’ll enjoy the game![/p]

notes.title: [Exhibition Announcement] We're heading to Tokyo Game Dungeon 9!
notes.content:
[p]We'll be exhibiting at [b]Tokyo Game Dungeon 9[/b] on [b]Sunday, August 3rd, 2025[/b]![/p][p]A playable demo will be available at the venue.
The developer will also be present at the booth — feel free to stop by and say hello![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Date[/b]: Sunday, August 3, 2025 — 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM
[b]Venue[/b]: Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba, Tokyo Metropolitan Industrial Trade Center Hamamatsuchō-kan
[b]Booth[/b]: 4R-12 (4th Floor, North Area)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628157/3d11dc47ae1da6f24b04273be5601d1d4137eff1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Official Site[/b]: [url="https://gamedungeon.jp/events/tokyo9/exhibit_informations?day=1&floor=4%E9%9A%8E"]https://gamedungeon.jp/events/tokyo9/exhibit_informations?day=1&floor=4%E9%9A%8E[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p]Set in a near-future dystopian world,
this mystery adventure RPG asks: [i]"What does it truly mean to be happy?"[/i]
Through choices, reasoning, and dialogue, you'll uncover the hidden truth behind the story.[/p][p]We'll also have [b]exclusive event content[/b] and [b]free goodies[/b] available at the booth.
Don’t miss this chance to experience the game firsthand — we look forward to seeing you there![/p]
